body:
Define the canonical agent roles used by Solace and their meaning.

### Scope
- Establish stable role identifiers and plain-language descriptions for Strategist, Investigator, Worker, Reviewer, and Coordinator.
- Coordinator is a new role to be expanded upon in future tasks.
- Put the role definition in the typed contracts/domain API so settings and the board use one source of truth.
- Add focused tests for the role set and serialization.

### Acceptance criteria
- The role list and identifiers are documented in one canonical definition.
- Settings and board code can consume the definition without duplicating role names.
- A role has a clear purpose and is distinguishable from its assigned model.
- The role set is covered by tests and any specification change follows the decision process.

### Out of scope
Choosing models, settings controls, model defaults for runs, Autorun behavior, and Agent Roles UI layout.
title: Agent roles: define roles
